# File and function comments — schema, infra, YAML, shell

The standard is `docs.mdc`; these are its examples outside TypeScript.

Header:

```hcl
# GitHub Actions OIDC provider + IAM role that may push ECR and deploy Express.
# In the app: Deploy workflow assumes this role; nobody uses long-lived AWS keys.
# Used by: .github/workflows/deploy.yml (role-to-assume).
# Uses: github_org / github_repo / github_branch variables.
#
# If this account already has the GitHub OIDC provider, import it instead of creating:
#   terraform import aws_iam_openid_connect_provider.github <arn>
```

Schema: comment odd fields/models, not auth-library boilerplate field-by-field. Terraform: file header plus why-comments on non-obvious `lifecycle` / IAM conditions; variable `description` already covers inputs.

Why-comment:

```dockerfile
# Hoist so Prisma engines land at node_modules/.prisma (pnpm nests them otherwise).
RUN printf 'node-linker=hoisted\n' > .npmrc && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
```
